text:
micah: Quick preflight for tonight's regional rollout. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC, canary slices only. Asking ops for a last-capacity sanity check and SLO rollback thresholds. change window 22:00-02:00 UTC.
sara: Ack, what's the canary % and hold intervals?
micah: Canary 5% traffic US for 20m, if healthy -> 25% for 30m, then full ramp. EU follows same pattern but start only after US steady for 40m. APAC last.
micah: Pinned model: redwood-model-1.4.0 (commit sha abc123). Fallback versions: 1.3.2-quant and 1.4.0-hem; deploy-bot will auto-fallback to 1.3.2 if error rate > 3% sustained for 2m.
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout created by @micah: rollout_id=rl-2026-03-21-09, slices=[US:5%,US:25%->100,E:5%...], staged=true
jia: Ops checks in — current warm pool reserved for this customer is 42% across US zones, can absorb canary surges. GPU slot cushion measured at ~38% (target >=30%).
kevin: Quick note: EU capacity in eu-west has scheduled maintenance tonight at 23:30 UTC for 15m. We should gate EU start until that completes or route to eu-central.
micah: Good catch. Let's delay EU start by 40m past 23:30 (-> start earliest 00:10 UTC) or choose eu-central. Preference: delay and monitor.
platform-sre: Adding thermal throttle guard: if avg GPU util > 85% in any zone for >3m, hold ramp and notify on-call. Also auto-reduce canary by half if queue latency > 300ms.
sara: Rollback signal checklist (copying): 
- error rate spike > 2x baseline for 5m
- 95th p99 latency increase > 200ms over baseline for 10m
- consumer error reports >= 3 distinct customers in 10m
- infra OOM/driver errors logged
If any of these, hold and triage.
micah: We'll keep canary health dashboard open. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/1.4.0 (short link). Please add any last-minute known regressions.
ops-bot: preflight smoke test: token-cost check OK, prefix-cache warm rate 72%, kv-cache occupancy nominal.
jia: Load test summary from noon run: 5% slice QPS stable, p50~45ms p95~180ms, error rate 0.15%. Good to go for US canary.
kevin: EU capacity patch acknowledged. I've updated the calendar and set EU start earliest 00:15 UTC to account for drift.
micah: Can someone run a quick routing policy validation? We need latency-aware routing enabled so deploy-bot uses eu-central fallback if eu-west degrades.
platform-sre: Routing policy validated. Fallback priority: eu-west -> eu-central -> us-west for EU traffic. Config snippet applied: route_policy=latency_zone_priority("eu-west","eu-central","us-west").
sara: Who's on-call for incidents?
micah: @kevin primary, @jia secondary, @platform-sre for infra escalations.
deploy-bot: rollout rl-2026-03-21-09: US canary (5%) starting in 5m. Live logs: /deploy/logs/rl-2026-03-21-09
os-bot: Note — change window overlap with backup snapshot at 00:50 UTC. We will not run backups during EU->APAC transition window.
micah: Quick rollback policy: manual rollback allowed at any point. Automated fallback to 1.3.2 triggers only for infra-level error patterns (e.g., segfaults, driver crashes). For perf regressions we hold and revert traffic allocation.
sara: A couple of tiny asks: add a short blurb to release notes about canary metrics and who to ping, and pin the UI route to 1.4.0 only after EU confirmation.
jia: Running a final synthetic probe now and will report in 3m.
(deploy-bot updates) deploy-bot: US canary slice started. slice_id=us-c-01, target=5%
jia: Synthetic probe results: OK, p95=170ms, error 0.12%, trace sampling passed.
kevin: Monitoring dashboards look green. Warm pool holding fine.
micah: Proceeding to staged ramp to 25% in 30m if no regressions. EU holdpoint set; we'll not start EU until 00:20 UTC and confirmation from kevin.
platform-sre: Logging rate increase note: if logging ingestion spikes > 2x, we will throttle logs to preserve observability for incidents. Heads up to SREs.
sara: Acknowledged, added note in release page.
ops-bot: Thermal alert thresholds set. If any region breaches, automatic hold triggered and incident channel #incidents paged.
micah: Thanks team. If everyone is aligned, I'll mark rollout in the console and step away for coverage. Ping here for any immediate issues.
kevin: Aligned, watching.
jia: Watching and ready to rollback if needed.
sara: Thanks all — adding final change window summary to release notes and closing preflight. :thumbsup:
